The November 2023 NBER revision reports a 14% average productivity gain among customer-support agents. Limited gains for experienced workers narrow the benefit but do not erase this useful application.
The report accurately presents a dated OpenAI usage disclosure. User counts do not establish practical usefulness, and the figures are company claims rather than independent findings.

reviews.rationale: Studies available before the statement show substantial gains in professional writing and customer support. These practical applications contradict the broad usefulness claim under its fair plain reading. Missing image-tool studies and uneven benefits across workers limit generalization but do not defeat the counterexamples.
